blocks.text: Jab ionic compounds pani mein halte hain to woh ions mein toot jate hain, jinhen phir pani ke molecules gher lete hain.

blocks.title: Hydration aur enthalpy of hydration
blocks.text: Woh amal jis mein pani ke molecules solute ions ko gherte aur un se taamul karte hain hydration hai; pani ke molecules aur ions ke darmiyan forces ion-dipole forces hain, aur aqueous solution ke sab ions hydrated hain. Enthalpy of hydration, delta Hhyd, woh enthalpy tabdeeli hai jab standard halaat ke tehat solute ka ek mole zaid pani mein hal ho kar la-mehdood patla solution banaye; yeh hamesha kharij hoti hai, kyunke ion-dipole bond banta hai.
Hydration energy par asar karne wale awamil

Heat of hydration ion par charge aur ion ke size par munhasir hai, jo mil kar charge density, fi unit area charge, hai. Chhote ion par zyada charge bari charge density deta hai, aur bari charge density wale ions pani ke molecules se zor se khinche jate hain, to hydration energy bari hoti hai. Hydration ki enthalpies Na+ < Mg2+ < Al3+ aur Sr2+ < Ca2+ < Mg2+ ki tarteeb mein barhti hain, aur anions isi bunyad par samjhaye jate hain.

blocks.caption: Charge density aur hydration
rows: Milte-julte size ke ions par zyada charge

blocks.prompt: Do ions ka charge ek jaisa hai magar ek chhota hai; do doosron ka size ek jaisa hai magar ek zyada charge rakhta hai. Har jore mein kis ki enthalpy of hydration zyada exothermic hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Chhota ion aur zyada charge wala ion. Dono ki charge density, fi unit area charge, zyada hai, to woh pani ke molecules ke dipoles ko zor se khinchte hain aur ion-dipole bonds banne par zyada energy kharij karte hain.

items: Hydration: pani ke molecules ion-dipole forces se ions ko gherte hain; delta Hhyd hamesha kharij hoti hai aur charge density ke saath barhti hai (Na+ < Mg2+ < Al3+; Sr2+ < Ca2+ < Mg2+).
